subject: [PATCH v2 02/12] mm/khugepaged: count collapses where khugepaged makes them

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged functionality to count collapses where it makes them, rather than relying on the caller to increment a shared counter. The daemon is able to keep its own counter without interference from the shared path. This change simplifies the code and improves maintainability.
